question: How many claims were open at 31 December 2024?
final_text:
**1,437 claims** were open at 31 December 2024.

I counted claims reported on or before 31 Dec 2024 that had no closed date or a closed date after that day. Claims with an accident date before that but reported later were excluded, since they weren't known at the valuation date. No claim closed before it was reported, so the open-claim definition holds up. Of the 1,437, 359 have no closed date at all. The other 87 have a report date on the same day as the accident, which is plausible rather than a data error.

ANSWER: 1437

input.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS open_claims,
  SUM(CASE WHEN closed_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS never_closed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN report_date > accident_date THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS report_not_after_accident,
  SUM(CASE WHEN closed_date < report_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_before_report
FROM claim
WHERE report_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
  AND (closed_date IS NULL OR closed_date > DATE '2024-12-31')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_claims,
  SUM(CASE WHEN accident_date > DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accident_after_ye,
  SUM(CASE WHEN report_date > DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reported_after_ye,
  SUM(CASE WHEN closed_date > DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_after_ye
FROM claim
